rows.grounds: verb indicating the act of standing up
compound qualifying the placement as having six parts
adverb indicating repetition of the action

items.question: What ritual placement must be performed again when one rises from the seated position?
premises: A practitioner may rise from a seated position.
Rising creates the occasion for renewed ritual placement.
The prescribed placement is the six-limbed nyāsa.
items.inference: Therefore, upon rising one should again perform the six-limbed nyāsa.
items.plain_english: When one rises, then one should again place the six-limbed nyāsa.
